BREAKING NEWS: ALL SCHOOLS CLOSED DOWN IN CHINA DUE TO VIRUS
.
.
Schools in China have been closed due to the uncontrollable rise of new Metapneumovirus infections. Confirmed. India also confirmed 7 new cases of the virus in their country.
